description: The builder added two new normative requirements in this iteration — R6 (content quality / anti-fake, spec lines 28-32) and R7 (rate-limit honesty, spec lines 33-34) — but did NOT add corresponding rows to the 'Verification architecture (no-mock)' table (spec lines 36-43), which still enumerates only R1-R5. Per the spec's own done-definition (line 11: 'R1-R5 verified by fresh evidence' — also not updated to R1-R7) and the verification-architecture discipline, every requirement must have a declared check + pass condition. R6 and R7 are the precise anti-fake guarantees this product's paid nature depends on, yet they have no documented verification method, no pass criterion, and (see FIND-204) no executing test. The verification architecture is incomplete relative to the requirements it is supposed to cover.
